experiments.name: Ask students about slide review habits
experiments.method: Survey 50 students about their current slide review methods
experiments.support_if: More than 60% say they spend hours watching lectures to understand slides
experiments.weaken_if: More than 30% say they review slides in real-time during lectures

experiments.name: Test flashcard effectiveness
experiments.method: Give 10 students a set of lecture slides and ask them to create spaced-repetition flashcards
experiments.support_if: Students create flashcards in under 15 minutes
experiments.weaken_if: Students take more than 30 minutes to create flashcards
